skill.name: keyword-spy
skill.description: When the user wants to reverse-look-up every keyword an app ranks for using ASOScan's keyword-spy (the full set of terms an app appears under, community rank pool plus discovered terms), flagged by whether you already track them. Also use when the user mentions "what keywords does this app rank for", "reverse keyword lookup", "spy on a competitor's keywords", "what search terms is X winning", or "which of their keywords am I missing". For the fuller competitive picture, see competitor-analysis.
skill.summary: Analyze ASOScan keyword rankings for your apps and tracked competitors to identify relevant, untracked terms and shared rankings.
skill.author: asoscan

content.user_title: Find Competitor Keyword Gaps with ASOScan
content.value_statement: Competitor rankings can reveal relevant search terms missing from your tracking. This skill uses ASOScan results to summarize keyword coverage, shared rankings, and untracked opportunities.
actual_capabilities: Use connected ASOScan tools or authenticated API calls to retrieve keyword rankings for owned apps and tracked competitors.
Check tracked competitors and request approval before adding a competitor by store URL.
Summarize returned keyword coverage using community and discovered origins.
Identify relevant competitor keywords marked as not already tracked.
Present shared ranking terms and direct promising keywords to related validation and tracking skills.
Explain cached discovery status, API errors, and documented credit costs.
limitations: Requires connected ASOScan tools or shell access with an existing ASOSCAN_API_KEY.
Access is limited to owned apps and tracked competitors; adding a competitor requires a store URL and write permission.
The public API does not trigger fresh discovery, and newly added competitors may have sparse cached results.
Keyword lookups cost two credits; results do not prove relevance or guarantee complete search coverage.

use_cases.title: Find competitor tracking gaps
use_cases.description: Compare a tracked competitor with your app and shortlist relevant ranking terms that you do not track.

use_cases.title: Review an app keyword footprint
use_cases.description: Inspect your app ranking terms and separate community coverage from cached discovery results.

use_cases.title: Prepare a competitive keyword review
use_cases.description: Summarize shared ranking terms and propose candidates for later validation across client apps.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect your app
prompt_templates.prompt: Show available ranking keywords for my app [app name] in [country]. Report coverage and discovery status.

prompt_templates.title: Find untracked competitor terms
prompt_templates.prompt: For tracked competitor [competitor name], find relevant keywords my app [app name] does not track in [country]. Explain each selection.

prompt_templates.title: Review shared rankings
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [my app] with tracked competitor [competitor name] in [country]. Summarize shared terms, competitor ranks, origins, and untracked relevant terms.

prompt_templates.title: Build a validation shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether [store URL] is tracked for [my app]. Ask before adding it. Analyze [country] rankings, note cache limits, and shortlist relevant untracked terms.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: handle competitor setup and prepare validation candidates.

output_examples.input: Illustrative example: find untracked terms for a tracked task app competitor in the United States.
output: Coverage: 120 returned keywords, including 90 community terms and 30 discovered terms.
Candidate: daily planner, competitor rank 8, community origin, not tracked; relevant to your planning features.
Shared term: task manager, competitor rank 12, discovered origin.
Discovery status: cached. Validate candidate relevance before adding tracking.

output_examples.input: Illustrative example: inspect a newly tracked competitor with no cached discovery.
output: Coverage: six community terms and no discovered terms.
Discovery status: none. Background discovery has not supplied cached results.
This result is not a complete keyword footprint. Repeating the request immediately will not trigger a fresh crawl.

best_practices: Confirm the target app and country before requesting keyword data.
Filter opportunities for product relevance and review tracking status before recommending candidates.
Keep credentials private and obtain approval before adding competitors or making other data changes.
anti_patterns: Treating every competitor ranking keyword as relevant to your app.
Repeating requests to force discovery or claiming cached results provide exhaustive coverage.
Adding competitors without approval or assuming a read-only key permits account changes.

faq.question: What connection does this skill require?
faq.answer: Use connected ASOScan tools, or shell access with ASOSCAN_API_KEY already configured. Otherwise, the skill refers you to asoscan-setup.

faq.question: Can it inspect any app by name?
faq.answer: No. ASOScan exposes owned apps and tracked competitors. An untracked competitor must be added using its store URL, with approval and write permission.

faq.question: How many credits does a lookup cost?
faq.answer: A keyword lookup costs two API credits. Adding a competitor costs another two. App and competitor listing calls are documented as free.

faq.question: Will it discover fresh keywords immediately?
faq.answer: No. The public API uses available community data and cached discovery results. Repeated requests do not trigger immediate discovery.

faq.question: How are tracking gaps identified?
faq.answer: The skill selects competitor ranking terms marked as not tracked, then filters them for relevance to your app.

faq.question: Does this skill automatically track suggested keywords?
faq.answer: Its workflow focuses on analysis. It refers promising terms to keyword-intelligence for validation and keyword-opportunities for tracking.
